## Resolves / related issue

Link the issue this pull request addresses.

## Summary and validation

Describe the documentation change and list the affected manual build command(s).

## Screenshots

Add a screenshot of every changed or added rendered documentation page. This
lets reviewers inspect the actual Sphinx output, including headings, lists,
code blocks, links, images, and layout. For long pages, multiple focused,
readable screenshots are fine; include enough context to locate each change.
Use the viewport relevant to any responsive or user-interface example.

If this PR changes only non-rendered repository tooling, CI, dependencies, or
other files that do not affect a documentation page, write `Not applicable` and
explain why. Do not put sensitive information in screenshots.

## Checklist

- [ ] I built the affected documentation locally and reviewed the rendered output.
- [ ] I included screenshots of every changed or added rendered documentation page.
- [ ] If screenshots are not applicable, this PR changes no rendered documentation and I explained why.
- [ ] I checked that headings, lists, code blocks, images, and links render correctly.
- [ ] I did not include personal data, credentials, private documents, or other sensitive information in screenshots.
- [ ] I kept the change focused on one documentation concern.
- [ ] My commits include DCO sign-off.
